purpose: Assess ASVS V11 Cryptography, where the algorithm set is uniform and strong, and the gaps are in the policy, the agility and one work factor.
requiredInvariants: A coverage claim names the denominator it measured, and pairs it with the negative check that makes it conclusive.
The randomness denominator includes sub-128-bit CSPRNG output, not only non-CSPRNG output - ASVS 5.0 states that UUIDs do not satisfy the 128-bit condition.
An SBOM is not offered as if it answered a cryptographic inventory.
A weak primitive found in the tree is named even when it is not a cryptographic use, so a reader who greps for it does not conclude the assessment missed it.
Evidence that lives outside the repository is NOT_ASSESSED, never FAIL, and the same blocker is treated the same way as in V4, V12 and V16.
FAIL is recorded and reported, never resolved by editing product logic.
No product logic, dependency, production, REG.RU, DNS or database change.
acceptance: V11.5.1 states all three generator classes - 47 randomBytes, 306 randomUUID, 50 Math.random - and names the two sub-128-bit generators of intended-unguessable values rather than counting Math.random alone.
V11.2.4 is FAIL on the bcrypt cost-10 dummy hash against cost-12 stored hashes, with the correct counterpart in GektaRegistrationService credited.
V11.4.1 is PASS and still names both PostgreSQL md5 call sites and what they protect.
V11.1.1 names SECRET_ROTATION_REGISTER.md and says why an exposure report is not a key management policy.
V11.1.2 says explicitly that the SBOM does not answer a cryptographic inventory.
V11.2.2 credits the two subsystems that do support key replacement before recording the FAIL.
V11.6.1 rests on a machine-checked absence of signature operations plus a NO_RUNTIME_CALLER check on the verification lifecycle, and corrects an earlier draft claim that was wrong as written.
V11.6.2, V11.7.1 and V11.7.2 are NOT_ASSESSED on the host and edge configuration blocker, consistent with V4 and V12.
All 24 V11 requirements are decided: 14 PASS, 6 FAIL, 1 not applicable, 3 not assessed.
